description: This file defines a mock class named 'CommunicatorClientMock' for the 'ICommunicatorClient' interface, using Google Mock framework. It provides mock implementations for methods related to communicator client operations, such as adding references, opening connections, acquiring interfaces, offering, revoking, and closing.

classes.name: CommunicatorClientMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing the 'ICommunicatorClient' interface for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increases the reference count of the mock object (const method).

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count of the mock object (const method).

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Operates to open a connection with a wait time (overloaded for different parameter sets).

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Obtains a pointer to an interface, either by class name and interface ID or by wait time and version.

methods.name: Offer
methods.description: Offers an interface pointer for a given version and wait time.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes an offered interface pointer for a specified version and wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the communicator connection with a specified wait time.
